identity: Mono-black sacrifice-denial control: convert your own recursive fodder into a one-sided exile sweeper via Sothera, grind the opponent to an empty board, then win with recurred threats and Void card advantage. Eight printed removal spells (8 of 23 nonland) plus 12 Sothera creature-death instances do the grinding; three Void draw engines (Hymn of the Faller x2, Decode Transmissions x2, Voidforged Titan x1) do the out-carding.

restrictions.hard_extra_constraint: MAX 6 rare+mythic across mainboard AND sideboard combined; basic lands unlimited and exempt

mainboard.name: Sothera, the Supervoid
mainboard.oracle_text:
Whenever a creature you control dies, each opponent chooses a creature they control and exiles it.
At the beginning of your end step, if a player controls no creatures, sacrifice Sothera, then put a creature card exiled with it onto the battlefield under your control with two additional +1/+1 counters on it.

mainboard.name: Susurian Voidborn
mainboard.oracle_text:
Whenever this creature or another creature or artifact you control dies, target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
Warp {B} (You may cast this card from your hand for its warp cost. Exile this creature at the beginning of the next end step, then you may cast it from exile on a later turn.)
mainboard.role: Payoff — drain clock / denial redundancy on the same deaths axis

mainboard.name: Lightless Evangel
mainboard.oracle_text: Whenever you sacrifice another creature or artifact, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
mainboard.role: Payoff — sacrifice-TRIGGERED grower (not a dies trigger); assembly-gate 4th payoff copy

mainboard.name: Umbral Collar Zealot
mainboard.oracle_text: Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)
mainboard.role: Engine — free repeatable sacrifice outlet (zero mana, any time)

mainboard.name: Swarm Culler
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever this creature becomes tapped, you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do, draw a card.
mainboard.role: Engine — tap-triggered outlet + conditional draw; the only flying blocker

mainboard.name: Hymn of the Faller
mainboard.oracle_text:
Surveil 1, then you draw a card and lose 1 life. (To surveil 1, look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)
Void — If a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn, draw another card.

mainboard.name: Decode Transmissions
mainboard.oracle_text:
You draw two cards and lose 2 life.
Void — If a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn, instead you draw two cards and each opponent loses 2 life.

mainboard.name: Voidforged Titan
mainboard.oracle_text: Void — At the beginning of your end step, if a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn, you draw a card and lose 1 life.
mainboard.role: Engine — Void repeating end-step draw (locked-thesis component restored)

mainboard.name: Beamsaw Prospector
mainboard.oracle_text: When this creature dies, create a Lander token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.")
mainboard.role: Enabler — self-replacing fodder + the deck's only land accel (Lander)

mainboard.name: Gravpack Monoist
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature dies, create a tapped 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token.

mainboard.name: Embrace Oblivion
mainboard.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice an artifact or creature.
Destroy target creature or Spacecraft.
mainboard.role: Interaction — {B} destroy + sacrifice outlet on cast

mainboard.name: Tragic Trajectory
mainboard.oracle_text:
Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
Void — That creature gets -10/-10 until end of turn instead if a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn.

mainboard.name: Archenemy's Charm
mainboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Exile target creature or planeswalker.
• Return one or two target creature and/or planeswalker cards from your graveyard to your hand.
• Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature you control. It gains lifelink until end of turn.

mainboard.name: Dubious Delicacy
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flash
When this artifact enters, up to one target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn.
{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: You gain 3 life.
{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Target opponent loses 3 life.
mainboard.role: Interaction — flash -3/-3 + sacrificeable Food artifact + 3-point reach

sideboard.name: Chrome Companion
sideboard.oracle_text:
Whenever this creature becomes tapped, you gain 1 life.
{2}, {T}: Put target card from a graveyard on the bottom of its owner's library.

sideboard.name: Dauntless Scrapbot
sideboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, exile each opponent's graveyard. Create a Lander token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.")
sideboard.role: Sideboard — mass graveyard exile + creature body + Lander

sideboard.name: Thaumaton Torpedo
sideboard.oracle_text: {6}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Destroy target nonland permanent. This ability costs {3} less to activate if you attacked with a Spacecraft this turn.
sideboard.role: Sideboard — only nonland-permanent answer available to mono-black (slow: {6})

sideboard.name: Depressurize
sideboard.oracle_text: Target creature gets -3/-0 until end of turn. Then if that creature's power is 0 or less, destroy it.
sideboard.role: Sideboard — cheap instant removal for power <= 3

sideboard.name: Temporal Intervention
sideboard.oracle_text:
Void — This spell costs {2} less to cast if a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn.
Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card.
sideboard.role: Sideboard — targeted hand disruption; {B} with Void switched on
